title: Docs Updater dispatch result contract
description: v2.22 §2.B2 priority 5 (spec line 132) — single `docs_updater` role shared by the Phase (docs_updater_phase) and Final (docs_updater_final) call sites. Models the report_docs_updater tool result written to the orchestrator's docs result path. Phase-vs-final differences are carried in the dynamic payload, not the schema.
